what: Hosted Dream debugger and prompt interface on Luna2; verified web-triggered Unreal movement
why: Let the team submit text commands and inspect real model requests, camera observations and arm activity.
details: Actual browser submission ran two 48-step feedback cycles (3.74 s and 0.53 s inference). Captured 12.8 s overhead animation, fully decoded and visually checked. Web server on Luna2, Unreal worker on Mac. Voice and physical grasp/contact behavior remain unverified.
